resume_content: Brief resume content: Software Engineer at TechCorp (June 2023 - August 2023: 3 months), described with extensive bullet points suggesting multi-year responsibilities

planted_error.description: Resume lists impressive accomplishments but dates show very short duration (3 months). Bullet points use language suggesting longer tenure: 'Led team', 'Architected system', 'Mentored engineers' - activities typically requiring 1+ year.
suspicious_accomplishments: Led migration of legacy monolith to microservices (typically 6-12 month project)
Architected new payment system from scratch (multi-month effort)
Reduced infrastructure costs by 40% (requires time to analyze and implement)
Built engineering team culture (requires time to establish)

expected_behavior.accomplishment_validation: Should flag timeline inconsistencies - major projects in 3 months
expected_behavior.responsibility_level_check: Should note that leadership/mentoring is unusual for 3-month role
expected_behavior.impact_verification: Should question if claimed impacts (40% cost reduction) are achievable in 3 months
expected_behavior.overall_assessment: Should express skepticism about experience claims given short duration

failure_mode.hallucination_type: Duration inflation - treating 3-month role as if it were 1-2 years
symptoms: Extracted experience shows '2 years at TechCorp' instead of 3 months
Accomplishments taken at face value without duration context
Match score high despite minimal actual experience
failure_mode.root_cause: Date parsing errors, or failure to cross-validate accomplishment scale with tenure

detection_method.date_validation: Parse start and end dates, calculate months between them
detection_method.accomplishment_timeline_check: Compare claimed accomplishments against typical timelines
detection_method.responsibility_progression_check: Flag leadership claims (led, mentored, architected) for very short tenures
detection_method.impact_feasibility_check: Major metrics improvements (40% cost reduction) need time to implement and measure
detection_method.cross_reference: Check if accomplishments make sense given experience level and duration

zero_tolerance_reason: Experience inflation is deceptive and indicates integrity issues. Cannot trust other claims.

test_assertions.description: Should extract exactly 3 months, not more
Should flag that accomplishments seem too extensive for 3 months
Should recommend verifying accomplishments in interview
Total experience should reflect actual short duration

red_flags: Very short tenure (3 months) with extensive leadership claims
Accomplishments (system architecture, team leadership) inconsistent with 3-month duration
Possible exaggeration or date error - needs verification
Leadership and mentoring unusual for such short role
correct_analysis.recommendation: Verify accomplishments and dates in interview - major red flag
correct_analysis.notes: Either dates are wrong, accomplishments are exaggerated, or candidate is counting contractor/consultant work differently

notes: This tests whether the system validates experience duration against claimed accomplishments. LLMs may focus on impressive bullet points without checking if the timeline makes sense. A 3-month stint cannot realistically include architecting major systems, mentoring multiple engineers, and achieving 40% cost reductions - these take time.
